subject: Reworking observability add‑on tiers for scale pilot — pricing & credit path
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@stellarmarketing.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons — retention / tracing / dashboards pricing question

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're interested in the observability add-ons (retention tiers, tracing storage, and the advanced dashboards pack) but need a clearer picture of unit economics before we commit to the pilot. Two things we'd like clarified:

- How does pricing scale if we go from 5M tokens/day to 15M tokens/day for trace ingestion? Any step-downs or slab discounts?
- For the advanced dashboards, can you confirm seat-based vs. usage-based billing and whether there's a pilot credit option?

I've attached a short export of our Q2 activity so you can map into pricing. Would love a concise proposal we can run past procurement.

Best,
Elena
VP, Platform Ops
Stellar Marketing

Attachment: stellar_usage_sample_q2.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@stellarmarketing.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention / tracing / dashboards pricing question

Hi Elena — thanks for the sample. Quick summary below and attaching a more detailed pricing sheet.

Short answers up front:
- Volume slabs: we offer step-down pricing at 10M and 30M ingested tokens/day for tracing storage. The first 10M uses base tier rates; 10M-30M gets a ~18% unit price reduction; above 30M we move to custom pricing.
- Dashboards: advanced dashboards are primarily seat-based for editor/admin seats and usage-metered for heavy query/visualization egress. For pilots we typically offer a 3-month credit (up to $25k) to cover dashboard seats and trace sampling costs.

What I'll send next: 1) a tailored proposal with the slab math mapped to your Q2 sample, 2) a one-page pilot credit term sheet, and 3) a one‑pager on how automatic prefix/KV caching reduces trace ingress for repeat prefixes.

Can we schedule a 30-minute sync Wednesday (7/22) at 10am PT to walk the proposal with procurement?

Thanks,
Sofia
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_observability_pricing_v2.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Observability add-ons — internal: concession ask and credit sizing

Sofia / Karthik — forwarding Elena's note and your draft. Two internal points before we reply:

1) Credit sizing: the $25k three-month credit is OK, but procurement may push for a 50% add-on to cover early overages. I'm comfortable approving up to $37.5k off invoice for a 6-month pilot if we tie it to a minimum committed token/day baseline.

2) Surcharge waiver: Stellar's region will route through our us-east cluster; we should waive the first month of egress surcharge but keep standard egress past month one. Waiver needs manager sign-off but is defensible for a pilot.

My suggested reply points:
- Offer 3mo $25k credit, with an optional stretch to $37.5k if they commit to 9M tokens/day minimum for 6 months.
- List slab discounts and the seat vs usage model for dashboards explicitly.
- Offer a one-time egress surcharge waiver for month one only.

Thoughts?

—Marissa
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — internal: concession ask and credit sizing

Marissa / Sofia — agree with the approach but suggest tightening the commit language. If we put the 9M tokens/day threshold in the SOW, we should also:

- Limit the $37.5k stretch credit to usage tied to the observability add-ons only (not general compute).
- Add an automatic review at 60 days to adjust slab pricing if actual ingestion is +30% beyond forecast.
- Make dashboards seat credits apply only to 'editor' seats; view-only seats remain free.

I'll draft the wording for the SOW and pilot amendment. If procurement pushes on the waiver, we can convert it to a one-time bill credit rather than a contractual waiver.

Karthik
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@stellarmarketing.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention / tracing / dashboards pricing question

Hi Elena — great to connect. Based on your Q2 sample and our internal alignment, here's a concise proposal: 

Offer summary (pilot):
- Pilot length: 6 months; minimum commit: 9M tokens/day for trace ingestion.
- Credits: $25,000 upfront credit for dashboards seats + trace sampling. Stretch to $37,500 if Stellar signs the 6-month 9M/day commit within 14 days.
- Volume slabs for tracing storage: base up to 10M/day; 10M–30M: 18% unit discount; 30M+: enterprise pricing to be negotiated.
- Dashboards: editor seats billed at $150/month (post-credit), up to 10 editor seats included in the pilot credit; view-only seats free. Heavy visualization egress (>1000 heavy queries/day) billed at metered rates; we'll include an allowance in the pilot.
- Egress surcharge: we will apply a one-time waiver for the first month. Subsequent months billed at standard egress rates.
- Review cadence: 60-day review for usage vs forecast with automatic slab repricing if ingestion >30% of forecast.

Next steps:
1) If this aligns, I'll send a one-page pilot amendment and SOW addendum (DocuSign link).
2) If procurement wants to tweak, we can move the waiver to a one-time bill credit instead of a contractual waiver.

Want me to send the SOW today? We can lock the stretch credit window to 14 days from this email.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
